subject.title: fix(macos): prevent hatch and web chat from timing out on slow first replies

question: Should maintainers require observable macOS WebChat/hatch proof before merge, or explicitly override the proof gate for this Swift probe transcript?
rationale: The code path is well supported by source review, but the external-PR proof gate is not satisfied by an uncommitted Swift probe for a user-visible macOS app flow.

options.title: Require observable app proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted recording, app logs, accessibility transcript, or terminal/live output from an actual macOS WebChat/hatch slow-reply run before merge.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can accept the copied Swift probe transcript as enough for this bounded bugfix and own the residual app-level availability risk.

recommendation.title: Require observable app proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted recording, app logs, accessibility transcript, or terminal/live output from an actual macOS WebChat/hatch slow-reply run before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent adjacent native chat/session history and is the best available owner for setting the macOS proof bar.
